sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Postman Pat - Part 2 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Good afternoon. Prapor told me that you are the one who will help us to reconnect and find the lost letter. Great! I will be waiting."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Hand over the letter from Prapor's messenger

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +3,000 EXP
- 80,000 Roubles
  - 84,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 92,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
- Unlocks purchase of Salewa first aid kit at Therapist LL1
"Well, thank you! No wonder Prapor recommended you as a reliable and responsible person."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid | Notes |
| Sealed letter | 1 | Handover item | Yes | This quest item can only be found if the quest is active.; When picked up, this item is transferred to the player's quest item inventory.; If the player fails to extract with this item, they will lose it. |
The messenger body is located in a bunker on the main floor of Factory. For orientation, the number "1986" can be seen painted above the bunker on the wall. The letter can be found next to the body on the ground.

Completing this quest fulfils the objective for Postman Pat - Part 1.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: The quest name is a reference to the British children's TV show "Postman Pat."
